patterns.message: Use the `~/*` alias (tsconfig paths) instead of the upstream vercel/chatbot `@/*` alias. Imports starting with `@/` are forbidden.
Server-only persistence. Reach the server via a Route Handler / Server Action; do not value-import from client components.

no-restricted-syntax.message: chezy bans useEffect. See .agents/skills/no-use-effect/SKILL.md for the 5 replacement patterns and the useMountEffect escape hatch (import { useMountEffect } from '@chezy/ui/hooks/useMountEffect').
Inject config through packages/config (Valibot env parser). Direct process.env reads are banned outside packages/config and *.config-bound.ts files.
